t: Water and impact-resistant LED rechargeable torch with Flex-Power technology. Features 6 x adjustable zoom, dual-direction clip and a strong magnetic base that provides convenient hands-free lighting. Can be powered either via a single AA battery or a rechargeable lithium-ion 14500 battery (included). Rechargeable battery operation features high, low, strobe and turbo modes, with run times of 2.5 hours, 5.5 hours, 2 hours and 40 seconds respectively. When powered by AA battery the run times for high, low and strobe modes are 2.5 hours, 4.5 hours and 4 hours.
